irules_simulation_object_recipe.meaning: Inside the authored iRules simulation, list and dict values use the authored C8.4 object recipe the registry declares. Every list/dict producer and consumer that can run in the simulation takes its recipe from the single selector (object_materialization / OriginalAuthoredOperandScope); the physical C9 recipe is used only at an explicit allowlist of physical-only sites, enforced by a drift gate. The compound seal is not relaxed and no boundary reparse is added; a sealed object crossing realms is refused. The name-axis counterpart (store_original_c_array_member) follows as a separate change.
